verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payments API platform, so issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents restricted keys, permission scopes, or per-agent credential issuance. The docs cover payment flows, refunds, 3DS, test data and moving to production, and the probes cover llms.txt and OpenAPI paths; none of these address credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
